# R-LEAF

> Robotics Laboratory for the Environment and Autonomous Farming, INRAE, France.

R-LEAF is an agricultural and field robotics research group in INRAE's
Technologies and Information Systems for Agroecosystems (TSCF) research unit in
Aubière, near Clermont-Ferrand, France. Its work concerns autonomous navigation,
mapping, state estimation, control and robot interaction with natural environments.

## Laboratory

- [Research]({{ '/research/' | absolute_url }}): Perception and mapping, navigation and control, interaction with non-rigid environments, and selected papers with research writeups.
- [Projects]({{ '/research/projects/' | absolute_url }}): ORICA, the research programme led by Johann Laconte at INRAE.
- [Publications]({{ '/publications/' | absolute_url }}): Bibliography by year, with links to arXiv, IEEE, publishers, DOI records and HAL.
- [BibTeX bibliography]({{ '/publications.bib' | absolute_url }}): Machine-readable references and source identifiers.
- [People]({{ '/people/' | absolute_url }}): Researchers, doctoral students and alumni, with available academic profiles.
- [Resources]({{ '/resources/' | absolute_url }}): Student information and practical research guides.
- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}): Johann Laconte, Research Director, INRAE.
